en.s: The siege of Maymun-Diz, an unlocated fortress and the stronghold of the leader of the Nizari Ismaili state, Imam Rukn al-Din Khurshah, occurred in 1256, during the Mongol campaign against the Nizaris led by Hülegü. The new Nizari Imam was already engaged in negotiations with Hülegü as he was advancing toward his stronghold. The Mongols insisted that all Nizari fortresses be dismantled, but the Imam tried to negotiate a compromise.

zh.s: 迈蒙-迪兹要塞是一座地点不明的要塞，也是尼扎里派政权首领、伊玛目鲁克努丁·胡尔沙的据点。1256年蒙古军队征讨尼扎里派期间，围城战在此发生。蒙古统帅旭烈兀向其据点推进时，新任尼扎里派伊玛目已与他谈判。蒙古人坚持拆除所有尼扎里派要塞，但这位伊玛目试图协商折中方案。

en.s: The Battle of Qaqun was a military engagement between the Crusaders and the Mamluks in Qaqun. The Crusaders, who were led by Prince Edward, led a raid against the Mamluk fortress of Qaqun. Initially successful, the Crusaders failed to take Qaqun and were routed by a Mamluk relief force.

zh.s: 卡库恩战役是十字军与马穆鲁克在卡库恩发生的一场军事冲突。爱德华王子率领十字军突袭马穆鲁克在卡库恩的要塞。十字军一度占据上风，但未能攻下要塞，最终被赶来增援的马穆鲁克军队击退。

en.s: In 1305, the Delhi Sultanate ruler Alauddin Khalji sent an army to capture the Paramara kingdom of Malwa in central India. The Delhi army defeated and killed the powerful Paramara minister Goga, while the Paramara king Mahalakadeva took shelter in the Mandu fort. Alauddin appointed Ayn al-Mulk Multani as the governor of Malwa. After consolidating his power in Malwa, Ayn al-Mulk besieged Mandu and killed Mahalakadeva.

en.s: The Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War was a conflict between two cadet branches of the French royal family: the House of Orléans (Armagnac faction) and the House of Burgundy (Burgundian faction) from 1407 to 1435. It began during a lull in the Hundred Years' War against the English and overlapped with the Western Schism of the papacy.

zh.s: 阿马尼亚克—勃艮第内战是法国王室两个旁系之间的冲突：奥尔良家族（阿马尼亚克派）与勃艮第家族（勃艮第派）。战争从1407年持续至1435年，发生在英法百年战争间歇期，并与天主教会西方大分裂重叠。

en.s: The siege of Dâmbovița Fortress took place on 23 November 1473 when an army of Moldavia, led by Stephen the Great, besieged the fortress where Radu the Handsome, ruler of Wallachia, had taken refuge. After the loss at Vodna stream, in 18–20 November 1473, Radu the Handsome retreated to Dâmbovița Fortress (Bucharest). However, he did not have time to properly organize his defence, the fortress being besieged on 23 November by the troops of Stephen the Great.

zh.s: 1473年11月23日，摩尔达维亚军队在斯特凡大公率领下围攻登波维察要塞。瓦拉几亚统治者英俊的拉杜败于沃德纳河一带后（1473年11月18日至20日），退守布加勒斯特的登波维察要塞。然而，他来不及妥善组织防守，11月23日，斯特凡大公的军队便开始围城。

en.t: Seven days after being convicted of treason, Perkin Warbeck, a pretender to the throne of England, is hanged for attempting to escape from the Tower of London; his supporter John Atwater is executed with him
en.s: Perkin Warbeck (c. 1474 – 23 November 1499) was a pretender to the English throne claiming to be Richard of Shrewsbury, Duke of York, who was the second son of Edward IV and one of the so-called "Princes in the Tower". Richard, were he alive, would have been the rightful claimant to the throne, assuming that his elder brother Edward V was dead and that he was legitimate—a point that had been previously contested by his uncle, King Richard III.

zh.t: 被判叛国罪七天后，英格兰王位觊觎者珀金·沃贝克因试图越狱而被处以绞刑；其支持者约翰·阿特沃特也一同被处决
zh.s: 珀金·沃贝克（约1474年—1499年11月23日）是英格兰王位觊觎者，自称为约克公爵理查德，即爱德华四世次子、所谓“伦敦塔王子”之一。假如理查德仍在世，并且其兄爱德华五世已死、理查德本人具有合法继承资格，那么他本应拥有王位继承权；这一点此前曾被其叔父理查三世质疑。

en.s: The Battle of Humenné (Hungarian: Homonnai csata, Polish: bitwa pod Humiennem or pierwsza odsiecz wiedeńska) took place on November 23, 1619 near Humenné (eastern Slovakia) during the first period of the Thirty Years' War between the Transylvanian army and the Polish forces of Lisowczycy. It was the only battle of that war to involve the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. The battle was won by the Polish cavalry led by Walenty Rogawski against the Transylvanian corps commanded by George Rákóczi, the future Prince of Transylvania.

zh.s: 赫梅内战役（匈牙利语：Homonnai csata；波兰语：bitwa pod Humiennem 或 pierwsza odsiecz wiedeńska）于1619年11月23日在赫梅内附近（今斯洛伐克东部）爆发，交战双方是特兰西瓦尼亚军队和由利索夫奇克人组成的波兰部队，正值三十年战争初期。这是该战争中唯一有波兰立陶宛联邦参战的战役。波兰骑兵在瓦伦蒂·罗加夫斯基率领下击败了由未来特兰西瓦尼亚亲王乔治·拉科齐指挥的特兰西瓦尼亚部队。

en.t: Areopagitica was published on 23 November 1644 at the height of the English Civil War
en.s: Areopagitica; A speech of Mr. John Milton for the Liberty of Unlicenc'd Printing, to the Parlament of England is a 1644 prose polemic by the English poet, scholar, and polemical author John Milton opposing the Licensing Order of 1643, which had re-introduced censorship of books during the First English Civil War. Areopagitica is among history's most influential and impassioned philosophical defences of the principle of a right to freedom of speech and expression.

zh.t: 弥尔顿发表《论出版自由》
zh.s: 《论出版自由》（Areopagitica）是英国诗人、学者约翰·弥尔顿于1644年发表的一篇政论，反对1643年重新实行的出版许可制度。该文主张言论与出版自由，被视为捍卫表达自由的重要作品之一。

en.s: The Action of 23 November 1650 was a minor naval battle between Spain and France, in which a small Spanish squadron of 6 galleys commanded by Don Francisco Fernández de la Cueva, Duke of Alburquerque, captured an entirety of a French squadron of galleons under the Baron de Ligny, near Cambrils, during the Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659). The French fleet consisted of a galleon of 500 tons and 30 cannons, 2 of 300 tons with 20 cannons, and the last of 300 tons and 16 cannons.

zh.s: 1650年11月23日海战是西班牙和法国之间的一场小规模海战。西班牙一支由阿尔布开克公爵唐·弗朗西斯科·费尔南德斯·德拉奎瓦指挥的小舰队有6艘桨帆船，在法西战争（1635—1659年）期间于坎布里尔斯附近俘获了利尼男爵率领的整支法国大帆船舰队。法国舰队包括一艘500吨、装有30门火炮的大帆船，两艘各300吨、装有20门火炮的船，以及最后一艘300吨、装有16门火炮的船。

en.s: The 1733 slave insurrection on St. John (Danish: Slaveoprøret på Sankt Jan), also known as the Slave Uprising of 1733, was a slave insurrection started on Sankt Jan in the Danish West Indies (now St. John, United States Virgin Islands) on November 23, 1733, when 150 African slaves from Akwamu, in present-day Ghana, revolted against the owners and managers of the island's plantations.

zh.s: 1733年圣约翰岛奴隶起义也称1733年奴隶暴动。1733年11月23日，丹属西印度群岛（今美属维尔京群岛圣约翰岛）约150名来自阿克瓦穆（今加纳）的非洲奴隶起事，反抗岛上种植园的所有者和管理者。

en.s: The Battle of Hennersdorf, sometimes referred to as Catholic-Hennersdorf, was a minor encounter that took place on November 23, 1745 in Katholisch-Hennersdorf in Silesia (Prussia, present-day Poland) during the War of the Austrian Succession. The Prussians under Frederick II defeated the Austrians under Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine. The Prussians surprised the Austrians and Saxons in their cantonments in Lusatia with the most success at Hennersdorf. There a force of two regiments of hussars and two regiments of cuirassiers under Zieten attacked a small force of two battalions of Saxon infantry and three regiments of Saxon cavalry.

zh.s: 亨纳斯多夫战役有时也称天主教亨纳斯多夫战役，是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场小规模交战，于1745年11月23日在西里西亚的天主教亨纳斯多夫（普鲁士，今波兰）发生。腓特烈二世率领的普鲁士军队击败了洛林亲王查理·亚历山大率领的奥地利军队。普军突袭了驻扎在卢萨蒂亚的奥地利和萨克森军队，并在亨纳斯多夫取得最大战果。在那里，齐滕率领两个骠骑兵团和两个胸甲骑兵团，进攻一支小规模的萨克森部队；后者由两个步兵营和三个骑兵团组成。

en.s: The Battle of Fort St. George (or Fort George) was the culmination of a Continental Army raiding expedition led by Benjamin Tallmadge against a fortified Loyalist outpost and storage depot at the Manor St. George on the south coast of Long Island on November 23, 1780, during the American Revolutionary War. Tallmadge's raid was successful; the garrison was surprised, and many provisions and prisoners were taken.

zh.s: 圣乔治堡战役也称乔治堡战役，是美国独立战争期间的一次突袭行动的高潮。1780年11月23日，本杰明·塔尔米奇率领大陆军远征队，袭击了长岛南岸圣乔治庄园一处设防的效忠派据点和仓库。突袭取得成功，守军措手不及，许多补给物资和俘虏落入美军手中。

en.s: The Battle of Tudela (23 November 1808) saw an Imperial French army led by Marshal Jean Lannes attack a Spanish army under General Castaños. The battle resulted in the complete victory of the Imperial forces over their adversaries. The combat occurred near Tudela in Navarre, Spain during the Peninsular War, part of a wider conflict known as the Napoleonic Wars. Spanish casualties were estimated to be about 4,000 dead and 3,000 prisoners out of a total force of 33,000. The French and Poles lost no more than 600 dead and wounded out of a total of 30,000.

zh.s: 1808年11月23日，马歇尔·让·拉纳率领的法兰西帝国军队进攻卡斯塔尼奥斯将军指挥的西班牙军队。法军取得了彻底胜利。战斗发生在西班牙纳瓦拉的图德拉附近，是半岛战争的一部分；半岛战争属于更广泛的拿破仑战争。西班牙军队共3.3万人，估计有约4000人阵亡、3000人被俘。法军和波兰军队共3万人，阵亡和负伤人数不超过600人。

en.s: The Battle of Carpio or Battle of El Carpio took place at El Carpio, near Medina del Campo, Valladolid, on 23 November 1809, between a Spanish force of 19,000 men commanded by the Lieutenant-General Diego de Cañas y Portocarrero, Duke del Parque and a French force of 10,000 regulars and 1,700 cavalry under the General François Étienne de Kellermann during the Peninsular War.

zh.s: 卡尔皮奥战役也称埃尔卡尔皮奥战役，于1809年11月23日在埃尔卡尔皮奥附近发生。地点靠近巴利亚多利德省的梅迪纳德尔坎波。半岛战争期间，迭戈·德·卡尼亚斯·波托卡雷罗（德尔帕尔克公爵）中将率领1.9万名西班牙军队，与弗朗索瓦·艾蒂安·德·凯勒曼将军指挥的法军交战；法军有1万名正规军和1700名骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of Loschniza (Loshnitsa) or the second battle of Borisov was a meeting engagement that took place on 23 November 1812, between parts of the French army and parts of the Russian armies. The French under Nicolas Oudinot defeated in detail the Russian troops under Pavel Chichagov.

zh.s: 洛什尼察战役（也称洛什尼察战役或第二次鲍里索夫战役）于1812年11月23日爆发，是法国军队部分部队与俄军部分部队之间的一场遭遇战。尼古拉·乌迪诺率领的法军逐一击败了帕维尔·奇恰戈夫指挥的俄军。

en.t: Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis
en.s: The "Hundred Thousand Sons of Saint Louis" was the popular name for a French army mobilized in 1823 by the Bourbon King of France, Louis XVIII, to help the Spanish Bourbon royalists restore King Ferdinand VII of Spain to the absolute power of which he had been deprived during the Liberal Triennium. Despite the name, the actual number of troops was between 60,000 and 90,000.

en.s: The Siamese–Vietnamese War of 1833–1834 (Thai: อานามสยามยุทธ (พ.ศ. 2376 – พ.ศ. 2377), Vietnamese: Chiến tranh Việt–Xiêm (1833–1834)), was a part of centuries-long conflict between Siam and Vietnam for suzerainty over Post-Angkor Cambodia. After the Siamese–Vietnamese conflict over Cambodia during 1811–1813, Cambodia shifted from being under Siamese domination to the period of Vietnamese influence. Though losing Cambodia, Siam had always entertained the idea of retaking Cambodia.

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: A presidential election was held in Rhode Island on November 23, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Rhode Island voted for Democratic candidate Martin Van Buren over Whig candidate William Henry Harrison. Van Buren won Rhode Island by a narrow margin of 4.48%.

zh.t: 1836年美国总统选举罗得岛州投票
zh.s: 作为1836年美国总统选举的一部分，罗得岛州于1836年11月23日举行总统选举。选民选出4名代表，即选举人团成员，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，击败辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森。范布伦在罗得岛州以4.48%的微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Majaceite was fought in the First Carlist War. Ramón María Narváez y Campos was ordered to intercept the expedition of the Carlist general Miguel Gómez Damas. Narváez left Madrid in October 1836 with three divisions, while Gómez Damas left Ronda on 18 November 1836, entering Algeciras on 22 November. On 23 November, when he departed Algeciras, Gómez Damas found himself surrounded at the citadel known as Alcalá de los Gazules.

zh.s: 马哈塞伊特战役发生在第一次卡洛斯战争期间。拉蒙·玛丽亚·纳尔瓦埃斯·坎波斯奉命拦截卡洛斯派将领米格尔·戈麦斯·达马斯的远征军。1836年10月，纳尔瓦埃斯率领三个师离开马德里；戈麦斯·达马斯于1836年11月18日离开龙达，22日进入阿尔赫西拉斯。11月23日，戈麦斯·达马斯离开阿尔赫西拉斯时，在名为阿尔卡拉·德洛斯加苏莱斯的城堡被包围。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Denis was fought on November 23, 1837, between British colonial authorities under Lieutenant-Colonel Gore and Patriote rebels in Lower Canada as part of the Lower Canada Rebellion. The Patriotes were led by Wolfred Nelson. Gore was sent to quell the uprising in the Richelieu River valley in conjunction with a force led by Lieutenant-Colonel George Wetherall. Gore was the first to arrive at a Patriote-held site.

zh.s: 1837年11月23日，戈尔中校率领的英国殖民当局军队与沃尔弗雷德·纳尔逊率领的爱国者叛军交战，史称圣但尼战役。这是下加拿大叛乱的一部分。戈尔奉命与乔治·韦瑟罗尔中校率领的部队协同镇压黎塞留河谷的起义。戈尔的部队最先抵达一处由爱国者控制的地点。

en.t: 1840 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in South Carolina on November 23, 1840 as part of the 1840 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, rather than by popular vote, who voted for president and vice president. en.s: The 1946 Tasmanian state election was held on 23 November 1946 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. Incumbent Premier Robert Cosgrove continued to lead the Labor Party into the 1946 election.

en.s: The Battle of Chunj, also known as the Chunj Operation, was a military campaign fought between Pakistani and Indian forces from 25 June until 23 November 1948, during the Indo-Pakistani war of 1947–1948. The Indian 163rd Brigade first advanced from Handwara to Tithwal and from Uri to Urusa. The 163rd Brigade then launched an offensive from Tithwal, raising a threat to Pakistani-held Muzaffarabad.

en.s: The 1952 Durand Cup final was the 49th final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giant East Bengal and Hyderabad City Police on 23 November 1952 at the Delhi Gate Stadium in New Delhi. East Bengal won the final 1–0 to claim their 2nd Durand Cup title.

zh.s: 1952年杜兰德杯决赛是杜兰德杯第49届决赛。这项赛事是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。1952年11月23日，来自加尔各答的东孟加拉队与海得拉巴市警察队在新德里的德里门体育场进行决赛。东孟加拉队以1比0获胜，第二次夺得杜兰德杯冠军。

en.s: The 1957 Israel Super Cup was the first edition of the Israel Super Cup, an annual Israeli football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup. As the match was not set by the Israel Football Association, it was considered an unofficial cup, with the cup being donated by the family of Lt-Col Zivi Tzafriri, who died in battle during the Sinai War In the match, held on 23 November 1957, league champions Hapoel Tel Aviv had beaten Hapoel Petah Tikva 3–0.

zh.s: 1957年以色列超级杯是该赛事的首届比赛。以色列超级杯是一项年度足球赛，由上赛季顶级联赛和以色列国家杯的冠军对阵。由于以色列足球协会没有安排这场比赛，它被视为非正式赛事；奖杯由齐维·察弗里里中校的家人捐赠，他在西奈战争中阵亡。1957年11月23日的比赛中，联赛冠军特拉维夫工人队以3比0击败佩塔提克瓦工人队。

en.s: The 1958 Hessian state election was held on 23 November 1958 to elect the 4th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and All-German Bloc/League of Expellees (GB/BHE) led by Minister-President Georg-August Zinn. The election saw major losses for the Free Democratic Party (FDP) matched by gains for the SPD and Christian Democratic Union (CDU), which established itself as the major opposition to the SPD-led government.

zh.s: 1958年11月23日举行黑森州议会选举，选出第四届州议会。卸任政府由社会民主党（SPD）和全德集团／被驱逐者联盟（GB/BHE）组成，州长格奥尔格-奥古斯特·津恩领导该联合政府。自由民主党（FDP）在选举中大幅失利，社会民主党和基督教民主联盟（CDU）则取得进展，基民盟由此成为社民党政府的主要反对党。

en.s: The 1958 Bavarian state election was held on 23 November 1958 to elect the members of the Fourth Bavarian Landtag, and was notable for being held in the midst of the Casino Affair, which indicted several Bavarian politicians in the previous government on charges of corruption. The Christian Social Union in Bavaria (CSU) has won every Bavarian state election since 1958, as of 2026.

en.s: The Plentong by-election was a state assembly by-election that was held on 23 November 1959 in the state of Johor, Malaysia. The Plentong seat fell vacant following the resignation of its UMNO MLA Mohamed Noah Omar due to his appointment as the first Speaker of the Dewan Rakyat. He won the seat in 1959 Malayan general election, with a 3,434 majority.

en.s: Doctor Who is a British science fiction television series first broadcast by the BBC in 1963. The series, created by Sydney Newman, C. E. Webber and Donald Wilson, follows the adventures of the Doctor, an extraterrestrial being from a humanoid species known as Time Lords. The Doctor travels through space and time using a time travelling spaceship called the TARDIS, which has an exterior that resembles a British police box.

en.s: The Battle of Dak To (Vietnamese: Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh) in Vietnam was a series of major engagements of the Vietnam War that took place between 3 and 23 November 1967, in Kontum Province, in the Central Highlands of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam). The action at Đắk Tô was one of a series of People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) offensive initiatives that began during the second half of the year.

zh.s: 达克托战役（越南语：Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh）是越南战争期间在越南发生的一系列重要战斗，1967年11月3日至23日于越南共和国（南越）中央高地昆嵩省展开。达克托地区的战斗是越南人民军当年下半年发起的一系列攻势之一。

en.s: Operation Lancaster II was a U.S. Marine Corps security operation that took place in northern Quảng Trị Province, South Vietnam from 20 January to 23 November 1968 during the Vietnam War. The operation followed on directly from Operation Lancaster. The Marines patrolled aggressively. The response of the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) was mixed; prolonged lulls alternated with fierce fighting.

en.s: The Massacre of the Sixty, or Black Saturday (Amharic: ጥቁሩ ቅዳሜ?, tikuru kidami), took place on the morning of 23 November 1974 (Ethiopian calendar: 14 Hidar 1967), when 60 imprisoned former government officials were executed by the Derg at Kerchele prison (commonly called Alem Bekagn - "Farewell to the World") in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It was considered the sudden death of the hopes that Ethiopia's revolution, barely ten weeks old, could remain bloodless, as epitomised by the slogan "Ityopiya tikdem, yala mimin dem” — “Let Ethiopia progress, without any bloodshed”. It presaged the Red Terror and Ethiopian Civil War that would follow.

zh.s: 1974年11月23日上午，德格政权在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴的凯尔切莱监狱（俗称“Alem Bekagn”，意为“告别世界”）处决了60名前政府官员。这一事件也称“黑色星期六”（阿姆哈拉语：ጥቁሩ ቅዳሜ，tikuru kidami），埃塞俄比亚历为1967年哈达尔月14日。此事让人们对埃塞俄比亚革命还能否保持不流血的希望骤然破灭；当时革命才刚开始十周，口号是“让埃塞俄比亚进步，不流一滴血”。这预示着红色恐怖和随后爆发的埃塞俄比亚内战。

en.s: The Final Acts of the Regional Administrative LF/MF Broadcasting Conference (Regions 1 and 3) Geneva, 1975 is the internationally agreed frequency plan which was drawn up to implement the provisions of the Final Acts of the Regional Administrative LF/MF Broadcasting Conference (Regions 1 and 3) held in Geneva, Switzerland, in 1975. en.s: The 1980 Irpinia earthquake (Italian: Terremoto dell'Irpinia) took place in Italy on 23 November 1980, with a moment magnitude of 6.9 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). It left at least 2,483 people dead, at least 7,700 injured, and 250,000 homeless.

en.s: EgyptAir Flight 648 was a regularly scheduled international flight between Athens Ellinikon International Airport (Greece) and Cairo International Airport (Egypt). On 23 November 1985, a Boeing 737-200 airliner, servicing the flight was hijacked by the Palestinian terrorist organization Abu Nidal. The subsequent raid on the aircraft by Egyptian troops killed 56 of the 86 passengers, two of the three hijackers and two of the six crew.

zh.s: 埃及航空648号班机是一条定期国际航线，往返于希腊雅典埃利尼孔国际机场和埃及开罗国际机场。1985年11月23日，一架执行该航班的波音737-200客机遭巴勒斯坦恐怖组织阿布·尼达尔组织劫持。随后埃及军队突袭飞机，86名乘客中有56人遇难；3名劫机者中有2人、6名机组人员中有2人死亡。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 23 November 1986. They were called by Chancellor Franz Vranitzky of the Social Democratic Party (SPÖ), as he was not prepared to continue the coalition government with new Freedom Party leader Jörg Haider, who had ousted Norbert Steger at the party convention. The SPÖ won the most seats, and formed a grand coalition with the Austrian People's Party, as neither were willing to work with Haider.

zh.s: 奥地利于1986年11月23日提前举行议会选举。社会民主党籍总理弗朗茨·弗拉尼茨基不愿继续与自由党组成联合政府，因此宣布提前选举；当时自由党新任党魁约尔格·海德尔刚在党代会上击败诺贝特·施特格尔。社会民主党赢得最多席位，并与奥地利人民党组成大联合政府，因为双方都不愿与海德尔合作。

en.s: The 1989 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the third annual Survivor Series and took place on Thanksgiving Day in the United States on Thursday, November 23, 1989, at the Rosemont Horizon in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. en.t: Freddie Mercury publicly confirms he has AIDS

en.t: Hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 crashes off Grande Comore
en.s: Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 was hijacked on November 23, 1996, after taking off from Addis Ababa. When the Boeing 767 ran out of fuel, its pilots attempted to ditch near Grande Comore in the Indian Ocean. The aircraft broke apart, and 125 of the 175 people aboard died.

en.s: The Convention on Cybercrime, also known as the Budapest Convention on Cybercrime or the Budapest Convention, is the first international treaty seeking to address Internet and computer crime (cybercrime) harmonizing national laws, improving investigative techniques, and increasing cooperation among nations. It was drawn up by the Council of Europe in Strasbourg, France, with the active participation of the Council of Europe's observer states Canada, Japan, the Philippines, South Africa and the United States.

en.s: Space Shuttle Endeavour (Orbiter Vehicle Designation: OV-105) is a retired orbiter from NASA's Space Shuttle program and the fifth and final operational Shuttle built. It embarked on its first mission, STS-49, in May 1992 and its 25th and final mission, STS-134, in May 2011. zh.s: 奋进号航天飞机（轨道器编号OV-105）是NASA航天飞机计划中的一架退役轨道器，也是建造的第五架、最后一架投入运营的航天飞机。它于1992年5月执行首次任务STS-49，2011年5月执行第25次、也是最后一次任务STS-134。原本预计STS-134将是航天飞机计划的最后一次任务，但美国国会批准了STS-135任务后，亚特兰蒂斯号成为最后一架飞行的航天飞机。

en.s: The Maguindanao massacre, also known as the Ampatuan massacre after the town where the mass graves were found, occurred on the morning of November 23, 2009, in the town of Ampatuan in Maguindanao province, on the island of Mindanao in the Philippines. While the 58 victims were on their way to file a certificate of candidacy for Esmael Mangudadatu, vice mayor of Buluan town, they were kidnapped and killed.

zh.s: 马京达瑙大屠杀也称安帕图安大屠杀，名称来自发现集体墓穴的城镇。事件发生于2009年11月23日上午，地点是菲律宾棉兰老岛马京达瑙省的安帕图安镇。58名受害者当时正前往为布卢安镇副市长埃斯梅尔·曼古达达图提交候选人资格证书，途中遭绑架并被杀害。

en.s: The 2009 Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation election was conducted on 23 November 2009 to elect members to all 150 wards of the municipal corporation. These were the first elections since to the GHMC since its creation in 2007. About 43% of the 57 lakh (5.7 million) voters cast their vote in the polls. The Indian National Congress and the All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen formed the government in a post-poll agreement.

zh.t: 2009年大海得拉巴市政公司选举
zh.s: 2009年大海得拉巴市政公司选举于2009年11月23日举行，选出市政公司全部150个选区的议员。这是该公司2007年成立后举行的首次选举。约有43%的选民投票，即570万选民中的约245万人。印度国民大会党和全印度穆斯林联盟在选举后达成协议并组成政府。

en.s: Shoot Boxing World Tournament 2010 or S-Cup 2010 was a shoot boxing event promoted by Caesar Takeshi. It was the seven bi-annual (70kg/154lbs weight class) Shoot Boxing World Tournament, featuring an eight-man single elimination format, with one reserve fight, all fought under Shoot Boxing Rules. The eight finalists and two reserve fighters were a mixture of invitees or had been involved in previous events (for more detail on this see the bulleted list below). As well as tournament matches there were also two 'Opening Fights', a 'Women's Fight' and three 'Super Fights' all fought under Shoot Boxing Rules (various weight classes).

zh.s: 2010年Shoot Boxing世界锦标赛（S-Cup 2010）由Caesar Takeshi主办。这是该赛事70公斤级的第七届比赛，采用8人单败淘汰赛制，另设一场替补赛，均按Shoot Boxing规则进行。8名正式选手和2名替补选手中，有人受邀参赛，也有人参加过此前的赛事。赛事还安排了两场开场赛、一场女子赛和三场不同级别的超级赛。

en.s: The Bombardment of Yeonpyeongdo (Korean: 연평도 포격전) was an artillery engagement between the North Korean military and South Korean forces stationed on the island Yeonpyeongdo on 23 November 2010. Following a South Korean artillery exercise in disputed waters near the island, North Korean forces fired around 170 artillery shells and rockets at Yeonpyeongdo, hitting both military and civilian targets. Shelling caused widespread damage on Yeonpyeongdo.

zh.s: 2010年11月23日，朝鲜军队与驻守延坪岛的韩国部队发生炮战，史称延坪岛炮击事件（韩语：연평도 포격전）。此前，韩国在该岛附近的争议海域进行炮兵演习。随后朝鲜向延坪岛发射约170枚炮弹和火箭弹，击中军事和民用目标，造成岛上大范围破坏。

en.s: The Emilia-Romagna regional election of 2014 took place on 23 November 2014. The three-term incumbent President of the Region, Vasco Errani of the centre-left Democratic Party resigned in July 2014 after the conviction for fraudulent misrepresentation, triggering a snap election. In an election marked by the lowest turnout ever in the Region (37.7%), Stefano Bonaccini, a Democrat, was elected President by defeating several candidates, mainly Alan Fabbri of Lega Nord Emilia (29.9%) and Giulia Gibertoni of the Five Star Movement (13.3%).

zh.t: 2014年艾米利亚-罗马涅大区选举
zh.s: 2014年艾米利亚-罗马涅大区选举于2014年11月23日举行。已连任三届的大区主席、左中派民主党成员瓦斯科·埃拉尼于2014年7月因欺诈性虚假陈述罪名成立而辞职，促成提前选举。这次选举的投票率为该大区历史最低，仅37.7%。民主党人斯特凡诺·博纳奇尼击败多名候选人，当选主席；主要对手包括北方联盟艾米利亚的艾伦·法布里（29.9%）和五星运动的朱莉娅·吉贝尔托尼（13.3%）。

en.s: Survivor Series (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on November 23, 2014 at the Scottrade Center in St. Louis, Missouri. The 28th event under the Survivor Series chronology, this edition was notable for the first appearance of former World Championship Wrestling (WCW) wrestler Sting in WWE, who had a long hold out from the day that he had signed with the company. Also, this was the first Survivor Series since 2001's Survivor Series, where its not to be featured the World title match. Eight matches took place at the event.

zh.s: 2014年幸存者系列赛是WWE举办的一场按次付费观看赛事，于2014年11月23日在密苏里州圣路易斯的Scottrade Center举行。这是幸存者系列赛的第28届赛事。值得一提的是，前世界摔角锦标赛（WCW）选手史汀首次在WWE登场；他与公司签约后曾长期未露面。这也是自2001年以来，幸存者系列赛首次没有安排世界冠军赛。赛事共进行了8场比赛。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Tunisia on 23 November 2014, a month after the parliamentary election. It was the first free and fair presidential election since the country gained independence in 1956, as well as the first regular presidential election after the Tunisian Revolution of 2011 and the adoption of the Constitution in January 2014. Since no candidate won a majority during the first round of voting, a second round between incumbent Moncef Marzouki and Nidaa Tounes candidate Beji Caid Essebsi took place on 21 December. On 22 December official results showed that Essebsi won the election, with 55.68% of the run-off vote.

zh.s: 突尼斯于2014年11月23日举行总统选举，比议会选举晚一个月。这是突尼斯1956年独立以来首次自由、公正的总统选举，也是2011年突尼斯革命和2014年1月通过宪法后举行的首次常规总统选举。第一轮投票无人过半，因此时任总统蒙塞夫·马尔祖基与突尼斯呼声党候选人贝吉·卡伊德·埃塞卜西于12月21日参加第二轮投票。12月22日公布的官方结果显示，埃塞卜西以第二轮选票的55.68%获胜。

en.s: The 2014 Norwegian Football Cup final was the 109th final of the Norwegian Football Cup. It was played on 23 November 2014 at Ullevaal Stadion, in Oslo, Norway. In the final Odd lost 2-0 to Molde, securing Molde's second cup title in a row and the double for the 2014 season. This was Molde's 7th cup final, while Odd traveled to Ullevaal for the 21st time.

zh.s: 2014年挪威足球杯决赛是挪威足球杯第109届决赛，于2014年11月23日在挪威奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场举行。奥德队以0比2负于莫尔德队，莫尔德因此连续第二年夺冠，并赢得2014赛季双冠王。这是莫尔德第七次参加杯赛决赛，奥德则是第21次来到乌勒瓦尔球场。

en.t: 2015 Party of Free Citizens leadership election
en.s: The Party of Free Citizens leadership election of 2015 was held on 23 November 2015. The incumbent leader Petr Mach was reelected. 574 members of the party voted. Mach received 2 thirds of votes. Petr Mach ran for reelection. Petr Hampl was considered his main rival. Hampl was considered far-right candidate. en.s: The Daraa insurgency was a conflict waged against the Syrian government and allies by various anti-government forces in Daraa Governorate as part of the Syrian civil war. en.t: 2021 President of the Chamber of Deputies of Romania election
en.s: Elections for the president of the Chamber of Deputies of Romania took place on 23 November 2021. The previous president, Ludovic Orban, elected in 2020, resigned on 13 October 2021 after losing the presidency of the PNL to Florin Cîțu, in the midst of the 2021 Romanian political crisis. The PSD candidate Marcel Ciolacu, supported by the PNL and the UDMR/RMDSZ as part of the then-new parliamentary majority, became the new Chamber president.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2021年11月23日选举众议院议长。前任议长卢多维克·奥尔班于2020年当选，他在2021年罗马尼亚政治危机期间，于10月13日因输掉国家自由党党魁选举、佛罗林·克楚当选党魁而辞职。社会民主党候选人马塞尔·乔拉库获新一届议会多数派支持，当选议长；支持者包括国家自由党和匈牙利族民主联盟／罗马尼亚匈牙利族民主联盟。

zh.s: 几内亚比绍于2025年11月23日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。总统选举和议会选举分别进行。此前，议会选举原定于2024年11月24日举行；2023年12月4日，乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛总统解散了由反对党控制的议会。2024年11月初，恩巴洛推迟了议会选举。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Republika Srpska, an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 23 November 2025, and repeated ones in 17 municipalities on 8 February 2026. The elections were announced by the Central Election Commission of Bosnia and Herzegovina after the premature removal of then-President of Republika Srpska Milorad Dodik from office by the Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina on 12 June 2025.

zh.s: 塞族共和国于2025年11月23日举行提前总统选举，并于2026年2月8日在17个市镇重新举行选举。波黑中央选举委员会宣布举行选举，此前波黑法院于2025年6月12日提前免去了塞族共和国时任总统米洛拉德·多迪克的职务。
